description: This header file defines APIs and data structures for managing Data Model objects related to cable modem channels and status, including functions for getting entry counts, entries, synchronization, and parameter retrieval. It supports part of a data model library for the RDK platform.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_DsOfdmChan_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of DS OFDM channels.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_DsOfdmChan_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a DS OFDM channel entry by index.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_DsOfdmChan_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the DS OFDM channel table has been updated.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_DsOfdmChan_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes DS OFDM channel data with the hardware/API.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_DsOfdmChan_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for DS OFDM channel.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_DsOfdmChan_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for DS OFDM channel.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_UsOfdmaChan_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of US OFDMA channels.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_UsOfdmaChan_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a US OFDMA channel entry by index.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_UsOfdmaChan_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the US OFDMA channel table has been updated.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_UsOfdmaChan_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes US OFDMA channel data with the hardware/API.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_UsOfdmaChan_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for US OFDMA channel.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_UsOfdmaChan_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for US OFDMA channel.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_StatusOfdma_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns total count of US OFDMA status entries.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_StatusOfdma_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a status entry for US OFDMA by index.

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_StatusOfdma_IsUpdated

methods.name: X_RDKCENTRAL_COM_CableModem_StatusOfdma_Synchronize
